content.short: BULB is a Write-to-Earn and Read-to-Earn blogging platform.
content.description: BULB reimagines how we read and write online by rewarding every interaction. In a Do-to-Earn model, you can write, read, share, react to, and comment on content to earn tokens. The platform nurtures a diverse community of writers, readers, dreamers, and opinion leaders who collaborate to shift value back to creators. By removing gatekeepers and recognizing engagement, BULB aims to transform online publishing from a passive scroll-and-consume experience into a participatory economy where contributions that were previously overlooked or unrewarded are acknowledged and rewarded.
